name: Fortified Wines

outcome.intro: After studying this section, a student will be able to identify major fortified wines, their styles, and the grape varieties typically used in their production.
outcome.certified: After studying this section, a candidate will understand the unique winemaking techniques used to make fortified wines. Certified Sommeliers will know iconic producers and be able to recommend and sell food pairings with fortified wines to a guest.

rows.certified: Be able to identify major regions on a map.
